entries.value: Normally, this material is not found in nature, but for some abnormal and unknown reason, it exists in the form of ore.
A classic arrow, usable with a bow.
Once known as the hardest material in the world, diamond has lost its reputation for rarity and extreme effectiveness.
Silver is a precious metal, but its quality leaves much to be desired for equipment improvement.
SquareBlock has a never-before-seen structure, with extreme rarity, making it the most resistant, lightweight, and hard material simultaneously.
This small piece of slime is very sticky and... Disgusting.
This very stable material is both beautiful and useful for crafting certain ancient technologies.
Dried grass for animals. (Or for you, if you're feeling a bit peckish.)
This slime heart appears to be the generator that produces the sticky layer on these small creatures.
Coal is widely used for cooking food or warming up during freezing periods.
This little cubic ant seems to be devoid of consciousness and camaraderie. It wanders alone.
This wing is very flexible, it’s an interesting material for… It’s an interesting material.
A snake’s fang. Careful, it’s poisonous !!! … Just kidding. A single fang isn’t dangerous, of course.
Very tasty and rich in vitamins.
Small healing potion. Nothing extraordinary. Restores 3 hearts.
This weapon is for tests. If u have this, wtf
A sword passed through many hands, used until its last breath. As dangerous as a toothpick.
A strike to send any threat flying. Just for pushing—they won’t feel much pain.
This helmet is for tests. If u have this, wtf
More goo than solid, but it works.
This chestplate is for tests. If u have this, wtf
Just think — a poor slime was killed, and now its corpse is your outfit. Bounces a lot. Way too much.
Those leggings are for tests. If u have this, wtf
Slime leggings, perfect for high jumps. Not that you could jump much before...
Those boots are for tests. If u have those, wtf
Makes a ‘splorch’ with every step. Stealth guaranteed.
Clearly fought a war... against time. Mostly protects you from compliments.
There are stains—maybe blood, maybe sauce. Either way, it sticks.
Partial protection: covers one knee out of two. Style bonus: none.
When your toes see the world before you do, it's time for an upgrade.
A sword made of bone. Not very sharp, but it sure hurts when it hits the nose.
Wearing a skeleton’s skull on your own. How charming !
This chestplate offers surgical-level protection. Ribs protect your ribs, the sternum shields your sternum… you get the idea...
If someone hits the armor's shin, it won’t hurt like hell this time... ...Unlike your fragile body.
Perfect for protecting your pinky toe from table legs or worse.
This spear has slain many slimes. It doesn't deal much damage, but allows for interesting critical hits.
This weapon allows you to strike vital points with effortless ease. Huge critical damage to save you from a situation by a miracle.
This aberration was tough... But now, if you have a full life, you have a high chance to shoot lasers when attacking. Handy !
Keeps your head safe and your hairstyle almost intact.
Light protection, but hey, at least it matches your shoes.
Strong enough for a fight, flexible enough for a dance.
Run fast, look stylish—what more do you want ?
Heavy protection. Don’t expect to hear much with this on.
Like a steel hug, if hugs crushed your ribs a little.
Warning: may squeak when you walk dramatically.
Clank clank clank, stealth is overrated anyway.
Looks like a salad, feels like a garden party on your head.
Made of leaves, eco-friendly, but don’t sit near a campfire.
Soft, green, and surprisingly good for your daily step count.
A dagger whose blade is the fang of a poor serpent. It doesn’t deal much damage, but it can poison your enemies.
She didn’t know how to use it, so she hid it in her bandages. Not very practical—and quite itchy.
A vile sword that can freeze your enemies. Be careful not to break the cold chain !
Originally, it wasn’t meant to be a weapon. However, the person who used it smashed their enemies so hard that fragments of SquareCoins got embedded in it.
A jagged blade forged from the remains of a colossal Shyron. Swinging it unleashes a fraction of the monstrous fury imbued by TheSquare.
A heavy chunk of eternal ice tied to a stick. Great for bashing skulls and cooling your drinks.
Forged from the lingering regrets of defeated phantoms. It feels surprisingly light, perhaps because it barely exists.
A blade designed to slither through defenses. If you listen closely, it faintly hisses when swung.
A holy rod blessed by ice priests. Useful for smiting evil or just whacking non-believers on the head.
A long polearm coated in disgusting gelatin. Good reach, but it slips out of your hands a bit too often.
A vicious little blade carved from a beast's claw. Perfect for quick, feral strikes in the dark.
A child's toy or a training tool. It hurts if you poke an eye out, but don't expect to slay dragons with it.
A blunt and absurdly heavy slab of rock. You need more muscle to lift it than to actually swing it.
A finely crafted blade gleaming with a silvery sheen. It looks expensive, try not to scratch it.
The reliable standard for any aspiring adventurer. Sturdy, sharp enough, and completely devoid of originality.
An incredibly hard and sharp blade. It cuts through armor like butter and makes you feel unnecessarily wealthy.
A weapon that defies the laws of physics. It obliterates what it touches, hopefully not including its wielder.
A blade with perfectly right angles. Its geometric perfection is as deadly as it is mathematically satisfying.
A soft and warm piece of fur. Great for making a coat, or just petting in stressful situations.
A very cold and rigid bug. Surprisingly crunchy, but probably shouldn't be eaten without heating it up first.
A beautiful flower that never wilts, mainly because it's completely frozen solid.
A freezing heart that still beats slowly. Holding it for too long might make your fingers go numb.
It keeps staring at you no matter how you turn it. Creepy, but maybe useful for something... gross.
A dark and heavy plate made of volcanic glass. Dropping it on your toe is highly disadvised.
The still-beating core of a gigantic Shyron. It radiates an oppressive, terrifying aura that whispers of TheSquare's dark designs.
An eerie, floating essence of a defeated phantom. Please do not try to talk to it, it has no mouth.
Light and silent footwear. Perfect for sneaking up on enemies or tiptoeing around at night.
Very cold boots that prevent slipping. Warning: your toes might go completely numb.
Winged boots that make you run incredibly fast. Trying to actually fly with them is not recommended.
Heavy boots made of volcanic glass. Great for stomping, terrible for swimming.
Boots that shouldn't technically exist. They make you feel weightless, but might annihilate the floor.
Woven from the dread-inducing hide of a Shyron. Every step reverberates with the terrifying might of TheSquare's behemoths.
Massive, furry boots. You'll leave huge footprints, confusing local monster hunters.
Perfectly cubic footwear. Surprisingly comfortable despite all the sharp right angles.
Boots that alter your personal pull. Just make sure you always remember which way is down.
Crafted from the armored scales of a gargantuan Shyron. They offer incredible protection, but occasionally whisper TheSquare's terrifying decrees.
Made of pure antimatter. Putting them on is easy, taking them off without obliterating the galaxy is the tricky part.
Perfectly angled at 90 degrees. They completely ruin your natural gait, but hey, you look incredibly geometric.
Keeps your legs chilled at all times. Great for summer, terrible for your knee joints.
Heavy, sharp, and incredibly durable. Running in these feels like dragging two anvils, but you won't get scratched.
They infuse your legs with the boundless energy of youth. You still have back pain, but your knees feel fantastic.
Includes built-in pouches and an irresistible urge to bounce around. Box gloves not included.
Literally just two hollowed-out boulders. Comfortable? No. Impenetrable? Absolutely.
Bound together by the fundamental forces of physics. Or just really cheap stitching, it's hard to tell.
A flowing robe that crackles with arcane energy. Doesn't stop swords very well, but you look incredibly wise.
Forged from the scales of a mighty beast. Smells faintly of smoke and roasted marshmallows.
Stained with questionable red spots. You keep telling people it's just ketchup, but nobody believes you.
A solid block of permafrost carved into armor. Highly effective until someone turns on the heater.
Extremely heavy and incredibly sharp. You'll probably cut yourself just trying to put it on.
Radiates an aura of absolute zero. Makes you completely unapproachable, emotionally and physically.
The pinnacle of theoretical armor. Just be careful not to hug anyone made of regular matter.
Torn from the hide of a gigantic, terrifying Shyron. Wearing it fills you with immense power, but also the oppressive presence of TheSquare.
A perfectly rigid box. It offers excellent protection at the cost of your ability to bend, sit, or breathe comfortably.
Held together by the strongest force in the universe. It's virtually indestructible, but very hard to take off at night.
Heavy lies the head that wears it. Also very pointy on top, which is quite impractical.
Features a built-in light that sadly broke ages ago. Still protects you from falling stalactites.
A perpetual brain freeze. At least you'll never need a cold compress again.
The less you think about what happens if you scratch your nose, the better.
A solid dome of volcanic glass. Impenetrable to arrows, but very bad for your neck posture.
A dark hood favored by cowards and shadows. It obscures your face and your moral compass.
Forged from the skull of a colossal Shyron. Its terrifying visage channels TheSquare's overwhelming, oppressive power.
A perfect cube for a less-than-perfect head. Great for stacking, terrible for peripheral vision.
Repels danger and occasionally your own hair. Keep away from fridges.
A burning orb that never stops radiating heat. Careful not to drop it on anything flammable.
A minuscule speck of pure light. It gently illuminates its surroundings and feels weightless.
Just a regular bone. It looks like it could be used for crafting or summoning something unpleasant.
A rare variant of the SquareAnt made of pure gold. It seems surprisingly heavy for its size.
A cold, mechanical heart. Despite being made of metal, it still beats with a steady rhythm.
A synthesized soul created through unknown means. It glows with an eerie, unnatural energy.
Raw material from The Square itself. It constantly shifts and reassembles into perfect geometric shapes.
